The cited result is not supplied.", "scope": [], "depends_on": ["n1"]}, "closed_predecessors": [{"node_id": "n1", "version": 1, "claim": "Cauchy's theorem supplies elements of orders 3 and 7 because both primes divide 21.", "text": "\\begin{proof}\n\n    By Cauchy's theorem we have that if $G$ is a group of order 21 then it has an element $a$ of order 3 and an element $b$ of order 7.", "scope": [], "depends_on": []}], "counterexample_search": true, "rule_candidates": [{"id": "grp_first_iso", "name": "First isomorphism theorem for groups", "statement": "If phi: G -> H is a group homomorphism, then G/ker(phi) is isomorphic to im(phi).", "conditions": ["phi is a group homomorphism", "ker(phi) is the kernel of phi"], "conclusion": "G/ker(phi) is isomorphic to im(phi).", "rule_digest": "335c687d26f64e41584f1b8bc575aec9d78223b01c4821bf0056bf8533de0c19", "applicability": "unchecked"}, {"id": "grp_normal_quotient", "name": "Quotient group criterion", "statement": "If N is a normal subgroup of G, then the set of left cosets G/N forms a group under (aN)(bN) = abN.", "conditions": ["N is a subgroup of G", "N is normal in G"], "conclusion": "G/N is a group and coset multiplication is well-defined.", "rule_digest": "f6d458aa2e7463efeea7a535cdbe0f0f7930259cfe7f845b5350ec03454da876", "applicability": "unchecked"}, {"id": "ring_quotient_ideal", "name": "Quotient ring criterion", "statement": "If I is a two-sided ideal of a ring R, then R/I is a quotient ring with operations defined on cosets.", "conditions": ["I is a two-sided ideal of R"], "conclusion": "R/I is a ring and coset operations are well-defined.", "rule_digest": "5c419f063bbc02eba57c0943d5ecce5f2e4c1b370cbb5ad6d69c2e08c3b21835", "applicability": "unchecked"}]}
